diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.clear_note: Engine off, ignition on. The readiness values are reset too. Tap again to clear.
diagnostics.readonly: Only reading. Clearing happens only while standing and on your tap.

state.failed: The control unit does not answer. Ignition on?
state.clear_failed: Clearing failed. Engine off, ignition on?
state.moving: Clearing is possible only while standing.

coolant_hot.title: Coolant temperature high
coolant_hot.say: Find a safe place to stop
coolant_hot.text: Find a safe place to stop and let the engine cool down at idle. Do not open the radiator cap while hot. If it does not improve: switch the engine off.

coolant_warm.title: Coolant is getting warm
coolant_warm.text: Drive on gently, turning the heating up helps cooling. Check the coolant level soon.

charge_high.title: Charging voltage too high
charge_high.text: The charge regulator may be faulty. Go to a garage soon, or battery and electronics get damaged.

charge_low.title: Battery is not charged
charge_low.text: Switch off large consumers (rear window heating, seat heating, fan). Have alternator and belt checked.

range.title: Range short
range.say: Go to the next filling station
range.text: Go to the next filling station.

lamp.title: Engine warning lamp on
lamp.text: Driving on is usually possible. If the lamp in the car blinks or the engine jerks: drive slowly and stop soon.
